The main takeaway from our work is that

the test derivation based on TFSMs with a single clock can return test suites of the same length as those derived based on FSMs and the length of test suites is independent of the number of clocks in a TFSM.

a test suite derived for a given TFSMs with a single clock has the length that is comparable to those returned by existing FSM based test derivation methods and it is significantly shorter than those returned by existing test derivation methods based on timed automata.
